new_user.reason: The empty state explains saving and finding context, but the import task mixes one-time intake and ongoing sync, and the central-directory option teaches the wrong responsibility.

functionality.reason: Import selection and completion work at fixture level, but required explanatory metadata and its saved/revision journey are absent. Parser identity and full import states are incomplete; most contract assertions remain untested in this diagnostic baseline.

simplicity.reason: The task is surrounded by repeated explanations, secondary navigation, and source-management panels. Routine import choices are displaced; native source cards duplicate the connected-source list.

clarity.reason: Visible source ownership conflicts with the required collector boundary. Import completion does not expose the missing Agent explanation or sufficient interpretation/recovery detail.

design.reason: A coherent restrained palette and typography establish hierarchy. The desktop system is consistent, while repeated nested cards weaken the mobile layout.

craft.reason: Evaluated screens render without horizontal overflow or browser errors. Keyboard, focus, all disclosures, and exceptional states were not comprehensively verified.

originality.reason: Context, citations, source management, and native status details are product-specific, though the interaction layout remains conventional.

android.coverage_scope: Focused baseline diagnosis; not an exhaustive acceptance run.

findings.title: Agent-understanding explanation is absent from input, completion, and detail
reproduction: From the empty library choose 导入已有文件.
Inspect all visible import form inputs.
Choose 研究资料.md, rename it, begin import, and open 查看这次导入记录.
findings.observed: Only name, parser, save mode, and image plan are represented. There is no optional freeform explanation or saved explanation/revision path.
findings.correction: Restore the existing optional 12,000-character prose field with concise examples. Preserve the exact multiline text and quote roles through input, review, edit, saved detail, and regeneration of the same task.

findings.title: Central-server directory intake remains visible
reproduction: Open the import form on each platform.
Inspect the origin tabs and the Web empty-home folder offer.
findings.observed: All three import forms offer 中央目录. Web empty home describes connecting a 工作台服务器 folder.
findings.correction: Remove all central-local directory collection and sync controls, guide entries, fixtures, and cross-links. Retain one-time browser file/folder upload and device-owned Mac/Android collectors.

findings.title: Repeated instruction and secondary panels compete with the immediate task
reproduction: Open Import at the evaluated viewport.
Open populated Sources on Mac and Android.
findings.observed: Import repeats one-time/sync distinctions in the description and a prominent callout; on Android these consume most of the first screen before file selection. Native source dashboards show large local-collector cards above a repeated connected-source list.
findings.correction: Keep a concise task explanation, primary selection action, and on-demand options. Use one source list with clear device ownership and contextual controls.

findings.title: The import detail is too shallow to establish the source contract
findings.observed: The detail shows selected file, name, save mode, simplified parser, device, and image scheme. It does not establish installed Source Pack/version, file-by-file dispositions, or separate original/interpretation/publication/memory stages.
findings.correction: Expose the audited interpretation and recovery detail at the decision point. Show source-specific selected values and outcomes; a generic settings modal or success toast cannot substitute.

limits: Only rendered DOM, screenshots, and ordinary fixture UI interactions were used. Candidate JavaScript and hidden state were not inspected.
This baseline establishes the known regressions and visual starting point. It does not claim complete inspection of 188 features or all adversarial journeys.
Native permissions, real backend execution, physical devices, live models, and production were not run.

An apparent disclosure-collapse defect was excluded: DOM-only timing checks stayed open; full-page screenshot capture altered the UI. Subsequent captures use viewport screenshots and observe DOM before capture.
next_round_priorities: Restore exact import prose and same-task revision/review/detail persistence.
Remove every central-local collection entry while retaining native collectors and browser one-time upload.
Reduce repeated explanations and duplicate source panels, especially on Android.
Evaluate all source-audited semantic controls and results; do not reuse historical route counts as a completeness claim.
contract_identity_clarification: Final freeze adds the already-applied cross-platform shared-workspace rule and corrects one source anchor. No baseline score, assertion, or candidate changed.
